ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a circle, with the circumference divided into four arcs by black dots, and the arc lengths are labeled 2, 5, 6, and x respectively. The small arc at the top is labeled 2, and two radii are connected from the center of the circle to the two ends of this small arc; the central angle formed by these two radii is labeled 30°. The two arcs on the right are labeled 5 and 6 respectively, and the arc on the left is labeled x. Reasoning: In the same circle, arc length is proportional to the corresponding central angle. The central angle corresponding to arc length 2 is 30°, and 30° is 1/12 of 360°, so arc length 2 is 1/12 of the entire circumference. Therefore, the circumference of the circle is 2 × 12 = 24. The circumference is composed of four arcs, so 2 + 5 + 6 + x = 24, solving gives x = 24 - 2 - 5 - 6 = 11.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a circle split by marked points into four boundary arcs labeled 2, 5, 6, and x, with the small top arc labeled 2 subtended by a central angle of 30°. Use the fact that arc length is proportional to central angle in the same circle. Since 30° is 1/12 of 360°, the arc of length 2 is 1/12 of the full circumference, so the circumference is 24. Then subtract the known arcs: x = 24 - 2 - 5 - 6 = 11.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个圆，圆周上用黑点分成四段弧，弧长分别标为 2、5、6 和 x。顶部的小弧标为 2，并且从圆心向该小弧两端连了两条半径，这两条半径夹出的圆心角标为 30°。右侧两段弧分别标为 5 和 6，左侧弧标为 x。
推理：在同一个圆中，弧长与对应圆心角成正比。弧长 2 对应的圆心角是 30°，而 30° 是 360° 的 1/12，所以弧长 2 是整个圆周长的 1/12。因此圆的周长为 2 × 12 = 24。圆周由四段弧组成，所以 2 + 5 + 6 + x = 24，解得 x = 24 - 2 - 5 - 6 = 11。

method.method_draft: From the diagram, identify the top sector whose boundary arc is labeled 2 and whose central angle is labeled 30°. Convert 30° to radians, giving π/6. Apply the arc length formula s = rθ to the known arc: 2 = r(π/6), so r = 12/π. Then the full circumference is 2πr = 24. Since the circle is divided into arcs of lengths 2, 5, 6, and x, set 2 + 5 + 6 + x = 24 and solve x = 11.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：附图中有一个圆，圆周被四个标记点分成四段弧。顶部小弧标为 2，右侧弧标为 5，右下弧标为 6，左侧弧标为 x。圆内有两条半径连到顶部小弧的两个端点，该扇形的圆心角标为 30°。
再推理：顶部弧长为 2，对应圆心角 30°。将 30° 转为弧度：30° = π/6。由弧长公式 s = rθ，得到 2 = r · π/6，所以 r = 12/π。圆的周长为 2πr = 2π · 12/π = 24。四段弧长之和等于整个圆周长，因此 2 + 5 + 6 + x = 24。解得 x = 24 - 13 = 11。
